Hello,
We temporarily adjusted (sealed) the clamp, but after a few charges the cable fastening will loosen again. Same issue as with other chargers (for e.g.: ID0477396). It is a recognized type error for this generation of Sicharge D. This helped earlier for other chargers: 8EM5905-0AA01-4AA6 Can you confirm the cable clamps replacement under warranty for this charger?
Thank you!
